page.overview:
What is Bardings?

The Dale-men, or Men of Dale, were the Northmen of Dale Town in the valley of Dale around the Lonely Mountain during the Third Age.

The Dale-men descended from the Men who had populated Rhovanion throughout the three ages of the Sun. They had dwelled in the valley of Dale since before the year 1856 of the Third Age. In that year, some Northmen who fled from the wide plains between Mirkwood and the River Running after the disastrous defeat of Battle of the Plains immigrated to Dale since they shared kinship.

After Thrór reestablished the Kingdom under the Mountain in the year 2590, more Men gradually came up the River Running and immigrated to Dale. It was in this year that Dale Town was built, growing into a wealthy township from trade with the Dwarves under the sovereignty of noble Lords of Dale.

In the year 2770, Smaug descended upon both Erebor and Dale probably from somewhere in the Grey Mountains. The Dale-men fielded warriors against him but could not prevent the dragon from burning much of their town. In the years afterwards, the Dale-men dwindled in number as Smaug would pick them off one by one to eat until, eventually, the remaining population fled and the deserted city fell into ruins.
